result.instructions: Tools for kiwiHR, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is off next week, and what time off do they have left?"; "List the active employees in the Sales team with their managers."; "Show Anna Novak's timesheets for last week and add a missing 09:00-17:00 entry for Monday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes kiwiHR data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run kiwihr_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kiwihr_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kiwihr_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. kiwihr_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_users
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List or search employees (kiwiHR 'users') with name, work email, active flag, employee number, employment dates, position, team, location and manager. Filter by active state, team, location, position, e-mail or name. Payroll, bank, tax and insurance data are never included. GraphQL query users.

is_active.description: true = active employees only, false = deactivated only. Omit for both.

employment_start_from.description: Only employees who started on or after this date.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). The reply's pageInfo.next says whether there is another page.

tools.name: kiwihr_get_user
tools.title: Get employee
tools.description: One employee by id: the list fields plus probation end, about-me, language, invitation status, work phones, all teams, work schedule and custom field values. With include_personal=true it also returns birth date, private e-mail and phone, nationality, gender, pronouns, home address, emergency contact and custom fields of the personal sections. Payroll, bank (IBAN/BIC), tax and insurance data are never returned. GraphQL query user.

include_personal.description: Also return private data (birth date, private contact data, address, emergency contact). Default false.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List teams and departments (id, name, kind GROUP or DEPARTMENT). Use the ids to filter employees. GraphQL query teams.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). The reply's pageInfo.next says whether there is another page.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List office locations (id, name). Use the ids to filter employees. GraphQL query locations.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). The reply's pageInfo.next says whether there is another page.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_positions
tools.title: List positions
tools.description: List job positions (id, name). Use the ids to filter employees. GraphQL query positions.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). The reply's pageInfo.next says whether there is another page.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the company's custom employee profile fields (id, name, section, data type, choice options). Payroll and bank sections are listed by name only; their values are never returned by any tool. GraphQL query customFields.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). The reply's pageInfo.next says whether there is another page.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_time_off_types
tools.title: List time off types
tools.description: List time off (absence) types such as vacation or sick leave: id, name, colour, visibility to team members. Use the ids with kiwihr_get_time_off_usage and kiwihr_list_time_off_balances. GraphQL query timeOffTypes.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). The reply's pageInfo.next says whether there is another page.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_time_off_balances
tools.title: List time off balances
tools.description: Time off balances of all employees: per employee and time off rule the allowance, accrued, used, requested, planned and available days, carry-over and the accrual/usage periods. Filter by time off type, active state and usage period. The API has no per-employee filter or paging for this query; read the result per user. GraphQL query timeOffBalances.

time_off_type_id.description: Only this time off type (from kiwihr_list_time_off_types).

usage_period_start_from.description: Usage period starts on or after this date.

usage_period_end_to.description: Usage period ends on or before this date.

tools.name: kiwihr_get_time_off_usage
tools.title: Get time off usage
tools.description: Who took (or requested) how much time off in a date range: per employee the request count and used days for each time off rule of the chosen time off types. Use it for absence reports ('who was off in March?'). Optional employee filters as in kiwihr_list_users. GraphQL query timeOffRequestUsageStatements.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). The reply's pageInfo.next says whether there is another page.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_timesheets
tools.title: List timesheets
tools.description: Daily timesheets of one employee (or the key's admin user when user_id is omitted) in a date range: expected, tracked, time off, holiday and break time in SECONDS, approval flag, time offs, holidays, entries (start/end, type, note, project) and break-rule violations. GraphQL query timesheets.

user_id.description: Employee id. Omit for the admin user the API key acts as.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). The reply's pageInfo.next says whether there is another page.

tools.name: kiwihr_get_timesheet
tools.title: Get timesheet
tools.description: The timesheet of ONE employee for ONE day (user_id omitted = the admin user the key acts as), with all entries and their ids (needed to update or delete an entry). Times in seconds. GraphQL query timesheet.

user_id.description: Employee id. Omit for the admin user the API key acts as.

tools.name: kiwihr_get_attendance_statement
tools.title: Get attendance statement
tools.description: Attendance summary of ONE employee over a date range: expected, tracked, total, time off and holiday time (seconds) and days, balance, overtime, meal vouchers, and tracked time per project. GraphQL query attendanceStatement.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_attendance_statements
tools.title: List attendance statements
tools.description: Attendance summaries of ALL employees over a date range (expected vs tracked time, time off, holidays, balance, overtime, tracked time per project). Optionally only employees with time tracked on a project, or with uncategorized time; inactive employees can be included. GraphQL query attendanceStatements.

project_id.description: Only employees with tracked time in this project.

has_uncategorized_time.description: true = only employees with tracked time not assigned to any project.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_overtime_balances
tools.title: List overtime balances
tools.description: Current overtime balance (seconds) per employee. GraphQL query overtimeBalanceStatements.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). The reply's pageInfo.next says whether there is another page.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List time-tracking projects (id, name, status ACTIVE or INACTIVE). GraphQL query projects.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). The reply's pageInfo.next says whether there is another page.

tools.name: kiwihr_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: One time-tracking project by id (name, status). GraphQL query project.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_journeys
tools.title: List journeys
tools.description: List onboarding/offboarding journeys (id, name, status DRAFT/ONGOING/COMPLETED/CANCELLED, assignee, journey type, custom date). Filter by status, assignee, type or team. GraphQL query journeys.

assignee_ids.description: Only journeys assigned to these employee ids.

team_ids.description: Only journeys of employees in these teams.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). The reply's pageInfo.next says whether there is another page.

tools.name: kiwihr_get_journey
tools.title: Get journey
tools.description: One journey by id with its steps (name, description, fixed start and due dates). With include_personal=true it also returns the private e-mail address stored on the journey. GraphQL query journey.

include_personal.description: Also return the private e-mail on the journey. Default false.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_journey_templates
tools.title: List journey templates
tools.description: List journey templates (id, name, description, type). Use a template id with kiwihr_create_journey. GraphQL query journeyTemplates.

journey_type_id.description: Only templates of this journey type.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). The reply's pageInfo.next says whether there is another page.

tools.name: kiwihr_list_journey_types
tools.title: List journey types
tools.description: List journey types such as pre-onboarding, onboarding or offboarding (id, name, key, archived date). GraphQL query journeyTypes.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). The reply's pageInfo.next says whether there is another page.

tools.name: kiwihr_create_timesheet_entry
tools.title: Create timesheet entry
tools.description: WRITE: add a time entry to the timesheet of one employee on one day (user_id omitted = the admin user the key acts as). type MANUAL = worked time (give start_at and end_at as HH:mm:ss, or a part_of_day), BREAK = a break. Optional project and note. Creates a new entry each call (not idempotent). Returns the updated day. GraphQL mutation createTimesheetEntry.

user_id.description: Employee id. Omit for the admin user the API key acts as.

part_of_day.description: For day-based tracking instead of start/end.

tools.name: kiwihr_update_timesheet_entry
tools.title: Update timesheet entry
tools.description: WRITE: change an existing timesheet entry (get its id from kiwihr_get_timesheet): times, part of day, project or note. Only the fields you pass are changed. Setting the same values again gives the same result. Returns the updated day. GraphQL mutation updateTimesheetEntry.

tools.name: kiwihr_delete_timesheet_entry
tools.title: Delete timesheet entry
tools.description: WRITE, DESTRUCTIVE: permanently delete one timesheet entry by id (get it from kiwihr_get_timesheet). This cannot be undone. Returns true when deleted. GraphQL mutation deleteTimesheetEntry.

tools.name: kiwihr_create_project
tools.title: Create project
tools.description: WRITE: create a time-tracking project (name, status ACTIVE or INACTIVE; default ACTIVE). Creates a new project each call (not idempotent). GraphQL mutation createProject.

status.description: ACTIVE projects can be used for time tracking.

tools.name: kiwihr_update_project
tools.title: Update project
tools.description: WRITE: rename a project or switch it ACTIVE/INACTIVE (INACTIVE projects can no longer be used for time tracking). Only the fields you pass are changed. GraphQL mutation updateProject.

tools.name: kiwihr_create_user
tools.title: Create employee
tools.description: WRITE: add a new employee record (first name, last name and work e-mail are required; optional start date, manager, teams, position, location and phones). Creates a new employee each call (not idempotent). No invitation is sent by this tool. Payroll and bank data cannot be set. GraphQL mutation createUser.

tools.name: kiwihr_update_user
tools.title: Update employee
tools.description: WRITE: change an employee's work profile: name, start date, about-me, work phones, position, team(s), location, manager. Only the fields you pass are changed (team_ids replaces the whole team list). Private, payroll and bank data cannot be changed with this tool. GraphQL mutation updateUser.

work_phones.description: Replaces the list of work phones.

tools.name: kiwihr_deactivate_user
tools.title: Deactivate employee
tools.description: WRITE, ACCESS-CHANGING: deactivate an active employee (typically after they leave): they lose access to kiwiHR and drop out of active lists. Reversible with kiwihr_activate_user. GraphQL mutation deactivateUser.

tools.name: kiwihr_activate_user
tools.title: Activate employee
tools.description: WRITE: re-activate a deactivated employee so they appear in active lists and can use kiwiHR again. GraphQL mutation activateUser.

tools.name: kiwihr_create_journey
tools.title: Create journey
tools.description: WRITE: create an onboarding/offboarding journey for an employee from a journey type and optionally a template (ids from kiwihr_list_journey_types / kiwihr_list_journey_templates). Creates a new journey each call (not idempotent). It does not publish it; check the status in the reply. GraphQL mutation createJourney.

assignee_id.description: Employee id the journey is for.

custom_date.description: Custom date steps can relate to (YYYY-MM-DD).
